mapper.select: select room_id as roomId, member_id as memberId, title, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from ai_chat_room where member_id = #{memberId} order by created_at desc limit 1

select message_id as messageId, room_id as roomId, sender_type as senderType, message, created_at as createdAt from ( select message_id, room_id, sender_type, message, created_at from ai_chat_message where room_id = #{roomId} order by message_id desc limit 20 ) recent_message order by message_id asc

select message_id as messageId, room_id as roomId, sender_type as senderType, message, created_at as createdAt from ( select message_id, room_id, sender_type, message, created_at from ai_chat_message where room_id = #{roomId} order by message_id desc limit 10 ) recent_message order by message_id asc

select cs.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , cs.address as address
, c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.connector_type as connectorType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.price_per_kwh as pricePerKwh , c.status as status
, vm.manufacturer as manufacturer , vm.model_name as modelName , v.vehicle_nickname as vehicleNickname , vm.connector_type as vehicleConnectorType
, round((ST_Distance(cs.location, sl.location) / 1000)::numeric, 2) as distanceKm
from vehicle v join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join saved_location sl on sl.member_id = v.member_id join charging_station cs on ST_DWithin(cs.location, sl.location, 30000) join charger c on c.station_id = cs.station_id where v.member_id = #{memberId} and v.is_default = true and v.is_deleted = false and sl.is_default = true and cs.station_status = '운영중' and c.status in ('사용가능', '예약중', '사용중') and replace(trim(c.connector_type), ' ', '') = replace(trim(vm.connector_type), ' ', '') order by case when c.status = '사용가능' then 1 when c.status = '예약중' then 2 when c.status = '사용중' then 3 else 4 end , distanceKm asc , c.charging_speed_kw desc limit 5

select vm.manufacturer as manufacturer , vm.model_name as modelName , v.vehicle_nickname as vehicleNickname , vm.battery_capacity_kwh as batteryCapacityKwh , vm.connector_type as vehicleConnectorType
, cs.station_id as stationId , cs.station_name as stationName , cs.address as stationAddress
, c.charger_id as chargerId , c.charger_name as chargerName , c.charger_type as chargerType , c.charging_speed_kw as chargingSpeedKw , c.price_per_kwh as pricePerKwh , c.connector_type as chargerConnectorType
, round((ST_Distance(cs.location, sl.location) / 1000)::numeric, 2) as distanceKm
from vehicle v join vehicle_model vm on v.model_id = vm.model_id join saved_location sl on sl.member_id = v.member_id join charging_station cs on ST_DWithin(cs.location, sl.location, 30000) join charger c on c.station_id = cs.station_id where v.member_id = #{memberId} and v.is_default = true and v.is_deleted = false and sl.is_default = true and cs.station_status = '운영중' and c.status in ('사용가능', '예약중', '사용중') and replace(trim(c.connector_type), ' ', '') = replace(trim(vm.connector_type), ' ', '') order by case when c.status = '사용가능' then 1 when c.status = '예약중' then 2 when c.status = '사용중' then 3 else 4 end , ST_Distance(cs.location, sl.location) asc , c.charging_speed_kw desc limit 1
